title: Add exhaustive focused status and model CLI regressions
description: Create a separate focused-stats CLI test file to avoid unnecessary overlap with the existing large test file. Cover plain, chart, and JSON output for status, model, and STATUS model; default and custom catalogs; zero-count statuses; unset models; lexical ordering; empty stores; long labels; status-first ambiguity; provider failures; and malformed or excess arguments. Verify quick queries never request handoffs and existing wtp stats, wtp stats STATUS, and legacy focused selectors remain byte- and JSON-shape compatible where applicable. Make only narrow implementation corrections exposed by these tests, then run go test ./internal/cli ./internal/stats and go test ./....

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Milestone: inspected existing CLI/stats coverage and added internal/cli/stats_focused_cli_test.go with focused status/model plain-chart-JSON contract cases, custom status-first ambiguity, zero/unset/lexical/long-label/empty-store behavior, provider failures, malformed/excess args, no-handoff checks, and legacy overview/focused compatibility assertions. Running formatting and focused tests next.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Verification complete: dedicated focused CLI regressions pass with go test ./internal/cli ./internal/stats and go test ./...; gofmt -d is clean and git diff --check passes. No production correction was necessary; unrelated existing worktree changes remain untouched.
